allow_instructions: Auto-run local development in this repo without waiting for a Run click: read and edit project files, python3, pip, pytest, lsof, curl against localhost, chmod, and start.command / uvicorn on 127.0.0.1.
Allow git read-only commands (status, diff, log, show) and restarting the local dCloud Content Manager app.
Allow searching the codebase and reading HAR or JSON fixtures in this repo for debugging.
Allow syntax checks (python -m py_compile) and installing requirements into .venv.
block_instructions: Always ask before git push, git reset --hard, force push, or deleting branches.
Always ask before rm -rf, deleting files, or modifying files outside this project directory.
Always ask before commands that read or write .env, credentials, or production dCloud systems beyond normal API calls the tool already makes.
